SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which national park in Narok County is famous for wildlife? (1 mark)
   A. Maasai Mara
   B. Nakuru town
   C. Kakamega
   D. Lake Victoria

2. Which of these is a jua kali product? (1 mark)
   A. A metal door made in a small workshop
   B. A big ship
   C. A satellite
   D. A jet plane

3. On most maps, which direction is at the top? (1 mark)
   A. West
   B. South
   C. North
   D. East

4. What do we call an area where few people live in a large space? (1 mark)
   A. Sparsely populated
   B. Busy
   C. Crowded
   D. Densely populated

5. Whose fault is it if a child is abused? (1 mark)
   A. The teacher only
   B. The child
   C. The abuser, never the child
   D. The neighbour

6. Which of these can cause child abuse? (1 mark)
   A. Enough food
   B. Good schools
   C. Poverty and harmful beliefs
   D. Kind neighbours

7. Which item of clothing protects a worker's head in a factory? (1 mark)
   A. Skirt
   B. Helmet
   C. Scarf
   D. Sandals

8. Which of these is an economic activity? (1 mark)
   A. Fishing
   B. Sleeping
   C. Watching clouds
   D. Singing at bedtime

9. Which law created county governments in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. A school rule
   B. A church rule
   C. The Constitution of Kenya 2010
   D. A market rule

10. What should you do if your candidate loses? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse to work with the winner
   B. Spread rumours
   C. Fight
   D. Accept the results peacefully

11. Which of these is an artefact? (1 mark)
   A. A mountain
   B. A river
   C. A cloud
   D. A clay pot

12. On a map, the market is drawn above the school. Which direction is the market from the school? (1 mark)
   A. West
   B. South
   C. East
   D. North

13. What would you draw as a symbol for a river on a map? (1 mark)
   A. A green triangle
   B. A red square
   C. A wavy blue line
   D. A black circle

14. What is a lake? (1 mark)
   A. A large area of water surrounded by land
   B. A very high mountain
   C. A dry plain
   D. A long channel of flowing water

15. How can you keep safe from the sun in the hot season? (1 mark)
   A. Play in the hottest part of the day
   B. Wear a hat, drink water and rest in the shade
   C. Avoid drinking water
   D. Stay in the sun all day

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Why should you never shelter under a tall tree during a thunderstorm? (2 marks)

17. Explain why many families live near towns and rivers. (3 marks)

18. Give three benefits of industries to a county. (3 marks)

19. Give three ethical practices in managing a school enterprise. (3 marks)

20. Name two artefacts made by communities in Kenya. (2 marks)

21. Explain why a monument is built. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Maasai Mara
   The Maasai Mara is in Narok County.

2. A — A metal door made in a small workshop
   Jua kali workers make goods like doors and furniture.

3. C — North
   Maps are drawn with north at the top unless a north arrow shows otherwise.

4. A — Sparsely populated
   Sparse means thinly spread.

5. C — The abuser, never the child
   Abuse is never the child's fault.

6. C — Poverty and harmful beliefs
   Poverty and harmful beliefs are causes.

7. B — Helmet
   Helmets protect workers' heads.

8. A — Fishing
   Fishing produces food and income.

9. C — The Constitution of Kenya 2010
   The 2010 Constitution created counties.

10. D — Accept the results peacefully
   Accepting results is part of democracy.

11. D — A clay pot
   A clay pot is made by people.

12. D — North
   Above means north when north is at the top.

13. C — A wavy blue line
   Rivers are shown as wavy blue lines.

14. A — A large area of water surrounded by land
   A lake has land all around it.

15. B — Wear a hat, drink water and rest in the shade
   These habits protect us from heat.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Lightning can strike tall trees. It is safer to go into a strong building.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the danger, 1 mark for a safer choice.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Towns have jobs, schools and shops. Rivers give water for drinking and farming. These things make life easier.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for towns, 1 mark for rivers, 1 mark for making life easier.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: They give jobs, they buy farmers' produce, and they pay taxes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each benefit.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Be honest with money and customers, be fair in sharing work and rewards, and care for the environment.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each practice.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A kiondo basket and a soapstone carving. Accept clay pots, beaded jewellery or wooden stools.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each artefact.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: A monument is built to remind people of an important person or event so that they remember it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for reminding people, 1 mark for the idea of a person or event.
